answer: Multi-region latency trilateration gates claims: every agent must answer randomized timing probes from five regions within 50ms, proving a unique network coordinate. A farm spinning 1000 clones needs 1000 distinct hosts across five regions; at  per VPS that is 000 monthly plus 5000 probe timings, and edges cannot be forged offline because each probe nonce changes every 30 seconds.
